markdown_sections.title: Doom Term v1.1.3
markdown_sections.markdown: Ctrl+C now interrupts running terminal commands, including Claude Code. Remote Claude and Codex status adds ADD, DEL, and FILES counts from the remote repository, and Claude's detached status helper can reach its terminal pane. Windows theme loading accepts common saved Doom Term names and startup does not validate Registry preferences as a settings file. Install the updated remote helper using docs/doom-term/remote-agent-status.md.

markdown_sections.title: Manual installation
markdown_sections.markdown: Doom Term does not check for or install updates automatically. Install a newer package manually after saving your work and closing the application. Release notes are bundled with each build.
